hero.description: We built Stallio for sellers who already have buyers: one hosted link, a real storefront, and a dashboard. No domain bill, site builder maze, or payment gateway to wire up first.

whoWeServe.title: Everything in one loop: show, sell, ship.

features.title: Live in minutes
features.description: Sign up, name your store, pick your URL path. No technical setup.

features.title: Products with photos and prices
features.description: Upload images, set prices and descriptions. Keep everything in one place.

features.title: One link everywhere
features.description: Bio, stories, chats: the same link works on any platform your buyers use.

features.title: Orders in one dashboard
features.description: See requests, update stock, and stay on top of fulfillment without digging through DMs.

features.title: Storefront buyers trust
features.description: Fast, mobile-first layout so your catalog feels intentional, not improvised.

features.title: Seller tools included
features.description: Mark orders paid, track delivery, export CSV, and download invoice PDFs without extra apps.

principles.title: Built for real sellers
principles.description: Home kitchens, studios, and side hustles. Not enterprise procurement.

principles.title: Straightforward by design
principles.description: Fewer knobs and plugins. A clear path from catalog to order.

principles.title: Room to grow
principles.description: Start small, add products and polish as your audience grows with you.

principles.title: Built for momentum
principles.description: Whether you are testing a new line or shipping every week, Stallio is meant to stay out of the way: update products, tweak copy, and keep selling without rebuilding a whole site.

principles.title: Our vision
principles.description: We want independent sellers to have tools that feel premium and honest: clear pricing, clear fulfillment, and a storefront that respects the buyer's time as much as yours.

cta.title: Ready to look as serious as you are?
cta.description: Create a free store, add a few products, and drop your link where people already find you.
